# Fernway Journeys

> Fernway Journeys is a small-group tour operator. It runs fixed-date guided trips capped at 12 travellers and designs tailor-made trips worldwide. Trips are led by local leaders, rated on a 1–5 activity scale and priced in US dollars per person. Prices start at about $2,490 for 8 days.

Key facts:
- Group size: 12 travellers maximum (8 on safari), average 9. Solo travellers can share a room at no extra cost or pay a single supplement.
- Activity scale: 1 Leisurely, 2 Easy, 3 Moderate, 4 Challenging, 5 Demanding.
- Booking: $500 deposit per person, balance due 60 days before departure. Free date change up to 60 days before departure.
- Departures marked "Guaranteed" run regardless of numbers. Others need 4 travellers and are confirmed 60 days out.
- Every itinerary lists an estimated footprint in kg CO2e per traveller per day, excluding international flights.
- Tailor-made trips typically start from $350 per person per day, excluding international flights.
- Contact: hello@fernwayjourneys.com. Fernway Journeys is a fictional brand; website concept by Codelynx Digital.
